title: 7 Best Herbal Tinctures For Eye Infection
intro: Herbal tinctures for eye infection are liquid extracts made from plants, herbs, and other natural substances that are used to treat and soothe eye infections. These tinctures offer numerous benefits, including reducing inflammation, promoting healing, and preventing bacterial growth, making them a popular alternative to conventional treatments. Examples of herbal tinctures used to treat eye infections include Eyebright, which has antimicrobial properties that help combat bacterial and viral infections, Goldenseal, which contains berberine that has anti-inflammatory properties, and Echinacea, which stimulates the immune system and helps the body fight off infections. Additionally, herbal tinctures like Calendula, Sage, and Yarrow are also used to treat eye infections due to their antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and soothing properties, which help to reduce redness, swelling, and discomfort associated with eye infections.
